svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT 0 field guide
svg.desc: Agent 0 reads the selected-scope roster, coordinates canonical tasks, integrates evidence and asks the designated owner to accept work.
svg.text: Coordination, roster, integration and owner acceptance
Plan one task, show the roster, gather evidence,
then ask the owner to review acceptance.
Agent 0 coordinates canonical tasks and integrates results.
A roster entry or context packet grants no access.
